title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Trio #05 (MoroccanZellige+CubistFragment+FilipinoYakan / EgyptianMamluk+JapaneseMakie+MexicanTalavera / KoreanEunipsa+ChineseCizhou+KoreanNajeon)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Russian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, a cold, striking expression, cheerful, pure icy-white hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Left woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Moroccan zellige tile mosaic (a deep cobalt ground with interlocking white, terracotta and gold motifs, wide gold bands, dense interlocking star-and-cross motifs) dominates one zone. Cubist-fragmented pattern (sharp angular asymmetric flat planes seen from several angles at once, wide silver bands, dense angular fragment planes) dominates the second zone. Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands, wide magenta-and-gold bands, dense geometric diamond work) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands framing her own face.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Ukrainian woman in her mid 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair, luminous skin, round warm red blush high on the cheeks, dark strongly defined straight brows, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large blue-grey eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural deep rose lip, and a wreath of real red poppies, blue cornflowers and wheat ears sitting on top of the head, a warm, calm expression, cool and composed, soft pastel-pink hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, matte finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay, wide gold-and-silver bands, dense geometric star inlay) dominates one zone. Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder, wide gold-powder bands, dense gold powder glittering densely) dominates the second zone. Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands, dense medallion scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: seated on a low stool, hands on knees.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform lace-up sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, sultry, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in wavy, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin carries 3 different painted patterns at once, together covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, each pattern claiming roughly an equal irregular share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework, wide bold silver bands, dense lattice fills) dominates one zone. Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic (a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, wide carved cream bands, dense leaf scrolls) dominates the second zone. Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer (glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands, dense dense scrollwork) dominates the third zone. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft and diagonal rather than a straight line, motifs blending gradually across an irregular border a few inches wide, pigment on living skin throughout, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.

Right woman's footwear: extreme plain stiletto pumps, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
